create or alter procedure [metrics].[BuildDataQualityMeasureQuery] @IncomingAllocationUid uniqueidentifier, @AssetVersionRollupPathUid uniqueidentifier as begin set nocount on; -- Working vars declare @MaxStartPosition int = 1, @FilterMatchType int = 1, @RollupPathUid uniqueidentifier; -- default weekly
select @RollupPathUid = RollupPathUid from metrics.AssetVersionRollupPath where Uid = @AssetVersionRollupPathUid; select @MaxStartPosition = max(StartPosition) from [metrics].[RollupPathLink] where RollupPathUid = @RollupPathUid; select @FilterMatchType = FilterMatchType from metrics.AssetVersionRollupPath where Uid = @AssetVersionRollupPathUid;
declare @tbl table ( StartPosition int, It nvarchar(25), Pt nvarchar(3), Sp nvarchar(3), Sa nvarchar(25), Sc nvarchar(3), Ep nvarchar(3), Ea nvarchar(25), Ec nvarchar(3), Col nvarchar(2500), Tab nvarchar(2500), Whe nvarchar(2500), Mat nvarchar(2500), Pat nvarchar(2500) )
insert into @tbl select I.StartPosition, cast(I.IntersectTypeID as nvarchar(25)), cast(P.[Type] as nvarchar(3)), cast(I.StartPosition as nvarchar(3)), cast(S.AssetTypeID as nvarchar(25)), cast(SA.Class as nvarchar(3)), cast(I.EndPosition as nvarchar(3)), cast(E.AssetTypeID as nvarchar(25)), cast(EA.Class as nvarchar(3)), '' as Col, '' as Tab, '' as Whe, '' as Mat, '' as Pat from [metrics].[RollupPathLink] I inner join [metrics].[RollupPathSegment] S on S.RollupPathUid = I.RollupPathUid and S.Position = I.StartPosition inner join AssetType SA on SA.ID = S.AssetTypeID inner join [metrics].[RollupPathSegment] E on E.RollupPathUid = I.RollupPathUid and E.Position = I.EndPosition inner join AssetType EA on EA.ID = E.AssetTypeID inner join IntersectType IT on IT.ID = I.IntersectTypeID inner join [Predicate] P on P.ID = IT.PredicateID where I.RollupPathUid = @RollupPathUid order by I.StartPosition, I.EndPosition
declare @rowCount int select @rowCount = count(1) from @tbl if @rowCount = 1 begin declare @IncomingAssetClass int = 7; select @IncomingAssetClass = T.[Class] from metrics.Allocation A inner join AssetType T on T.Uid = A.AssetTypeUid and A.Uid = @IncomingAllocationUid;
update @tbl set Col = iif(@IncomingAssetClass = 7, 'N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.Uid as StartingAssetUid, N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.Uid as TechnicalAssetUid, N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.Uid as RuleAssetUid, ', 'N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.Uid as StartingAssetUid, N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.Uid as TechnicalAssetUid, N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.Uid as RuleAssetUid, ' ), Tab = 'graph.AssetNode N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp + ', graph.AssetEdge E_'+It+'_'+Sp+'_'+Ep + ', graph.AssetNode N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+' ', Whe = 'E_'+It+'_'+Sp+'_'+Ep+'.PredicateType = 2' + ' and N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.AssetTypeID = ' + Sa + ' and N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.AssetTypeID = ' + Ea + ' ', Mat = 'N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'<-(E_'+It+'_'+Sp+'_'+Ep+')-N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep, Pat = 'select N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.Uid, '+Sp+' as Position ' + 'union ' + 'select N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.Uid, '+Ep+' as Position' end else begin update @tbl set Col = case StartPosition when 1 then 'N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.Uid as StartingAssetUid, ' when @MaxStartPosition then 'N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.Uid as TechnicalAssetUid, ' + 'N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.Uid as RuleAssetUid, ' else '' end, Tab = case StartPosition when 1 then 'graph.AssetNode N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp + ', graph.AssetEdge E_'+It+'_'+Sp+'_'+Ep + ', graph.AssetNode N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+' ' when @MaxStartPosition then ', graph.AssetEdge E_'+It+'_'+Sp+'_'+Ep + ', graph.AssetNode N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+' ' else ', graph.AssetEdge E_'+It+'_'+Sp+'_'+Ep + ', graph.AssetNode N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+' ' end, Whe = case StartPosition when 1 then 'N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.AssetTypeID = ' + Sa + ' ' when @MaxStartPosition then 'E_'+It+'_'+Sp+'_'+Ep+'.PredicateType = 2' + ' and N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.AssetTypeID = ' + Sa + ' and N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.AssetTypeID = ' + Ea + ' ' else 'N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.AssetTypeID = ' + Ea + ' ' end, Mat = case StartPosition when 1 then 'N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'-(E_'+It+'_'+Sp+'_'+Ep+')->N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep when @MaxStartPosition then '<-(E_'+It+'_'+Sp+'_'+Ep+')-N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep else '-(E_'+It+'_'+Sp+'_'+Ep+')->N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep end, Pat = case StartPosition when 1 then 'select N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.Uid, '+Sp+' as Position ' + 'union ' + 'select N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.Uid, '+Ep+' as Position' else 'select N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.Uid, '+Ep+' as Position' end end
declare @c nvarchar(max), @t nvarchar(max), @w nvarchar(max), @m nvarchar(max), @p nvarchar(max), @sql nvarchar(max)
select @c = string_agg(Col, '') from @tbl --order by StartPosition select @t = string_agg(Tab, '') from @tbl --order by StartPosition
update @tbl set Whe = null where Whe = '' select @w = string_agg(Whe, ' and ') from @tbl --order by StartPosition if @w <> '' begin set @w = ' and ' + @w end if @w is null begin set @w = '' end
select @m = string_agg(Mat, '') from @tbl --order by StartPosition select @p = string_agg(Pat, ' union ') from @tbl --order by StartPosition
declare @StartingAssetUidColumn nvarchar(250) = '', @TechnicalAssetUidColumn nvarchar(250) = '', @RuleAssetUidColumn nvarchar(250) = ''
select @StartingAssetUidColumn = iif(@IncomingAssetClass = 7, 'N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.Uid', 'N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.Uid') from @tbl where StartPosition = 1
select @RuleAssetUidColumn = 'N_'+Ea+'_'+Ep+'.Uid', @TechnicalAssetUidColumn = 'N_'+Sa+'_'+Sp+'.Uid' from @tbl where StartPosition = @MaxStartPosition
set @sql = 'select distinct ' + @c + '(select * from ('+@p+') A order by Position asc for json path) as [Path], ' + '( select Uid, PassFraction, EffectiveDate from ( select ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by ERO.$from_id, ERE.$from_id order by R.EffectiveDate desc, R.UpdatedOn desc) as RowNumber, R.Uid, R.PassFraction, R.EffectiveDate from graph.AssetNode TA, graph.AssetNode RA, dbo.AssetResultEdge ERO, --owns dbo.AssetResultEdge ERE, --evalby dbo.AssetResult R where match(RA-(ERO)->R<-(ERE)-TA) and TA.Uid = '+@TechnicalAssetUidColumn+' and RA.Uid = '+@RuleAssetUidColumn+' and ERO.[Class] = 1 and ERE.[Class] = 2 and R.EffectiveDate >= @MinimumEffectiveDate and R.EffectiveDate <= @MaximumEffectiveDate ) O where RowNumber = 1 for json path ) as [Results]' + ' from ' + @t + ' where match('+@m+')' + @w + ' and ' + @StartingAssetUidColumn + ' = @AssetUid'
select @sql as [Sql]; select @FilterMatchType as FilterMatchType;
-- Get the rule path filters for this measure version, to be used in where statement above. select F.AssetTypeID, F.FieldTypeID, FT.[Type], F.Operator, V.Value, Pos.WhereQuery from [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPath] P inner join [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilter] F on F.[AssetVersionRollupPathUid] = P.Uid and P.Uid = @AssetVersionRollupPathUid inner join [metrics].[AssetVersionRollupPathFilterValue] V on V.[AssetVersionRollupPathFilterUid] = F.Uid inner join FieldType FT on FT.AssetTypeID = F.AssetTypeID and FT.ID = F.FieldTypeID cross apply ( select top 1 'N_' + cast(OO.AssetTypeID as nvarchar) + '_' + cast(OO.Pos as nvarchar) + '.ID' as WhereQuery from ( select S.AssetTypeID, I.StartPosition as [Pos] from [metrics].[RollupPathLink] I inner join [metrics].[RollupPathSegment] S on S.RollupPathUid = I.RollupPathUid and S.Position = I.StartPosition and I.RollupPathUid = P.RollupPathUid and S.AssetTypeID = F.AssetTypeID union select S.AssetTypeID, I.EndPosition as [Pos] from [metrics].[RollupPathLink] I inner join [metrics].[RollupPathSegment] S on S.RollupPathUid = I.RollupPathUid and S.Position = I.EndPosition and I.RollupPathUid = P.RollupPathUid and S.AssetTypeID = F.AssetTypeID ) OO ) Pos end
